name: Entry marker
description: Green BUY arrow with the entry price. Warning entries (OVER, RISKY) use spike.warningColor.
_comment: Lightweight Charts marker options. position: aboveBar|belowBar|inBar. shape: arrowUp|arrowDown|circle|square. size: 0.5-2 recommended. build/display false removes this marker from the chart.

spike._comment: Warns on suspicious BUY entry shapes, labeled by expectation: 'over' when the entry close is >dipPct below the highest close of the prior peakCandles (the move already ran — historically ~-$19 avg, gated by lateEntryGate), 'risky' when >=minShare of the move arrived in the final tailCandles (high variance, ~-$10 avg). Tagged markers use warningColor so a risky entry is visually distinct from a clean one.
